name: Robregordo (Spain)
description: Green field with a white triangle with its base along the upper edge and its apex at the middle of the lower edge, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Robregordo (a tower on black, a bend and a tree on yellow).
history: Robregordo adopted its arms and flag officially on 30 June 1994; the flag is rectangular of proportions 2:3, divided by two lines running from the upper corners to the centre of the lower edge, the lateral portions green.
